ambiguities_or_notes: The source heading dates the letter 'April 15...30?' and English preserves that uncertainty despite simplified front-matter correspondence_date metadata.

The apparently contradictory wording 'поступить не в военную службу, а в стрелковый полк' is translated closely as 'entering not military service but the Rifle Regiment'; official volume 59 confirms this is the printed reading, so no silent emendation is made.
юнкер is retained as 'junker,' the military rank/status intended in context, rather than modernized to a broader 'cadet'.
